notes.title: Mix-Sign: Girl with 3 Signs in Spanish!
notes.content:
I came to give you very good news!
The game in Spanish is ready and you can play in Spanish.

If you have a game in your library, but don't know how to change?
I'll help you, just go to your library, go to your games list and look for the Mix-sign there, then right-click and there will appear the steam configuration. And at the end there is a language tab and you select "Spanish".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36431572/91044a3dbc2aa9fee33327b14c73f6e8f9208f10.png


P.S.: If text is wrong or bug, you can send a message about it. ( =>w0)/"')
